Definition: properly, aberration, i.e. (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem
BiblicalUsage: Habakkuk sets his prayer to Shigionoth, and the word stands in the title of Psalm 7, the psalm David sang to the LORD concerning Cush the Benjamite.
TheologicalSignificance: A song's heading is part of the song, and this wild, wandering poem is how a troubled man brings his trouble to God.
